speaker: Leonard
text: Do you understand that this was supposed to be a date? Do you?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Look at that, there's even pasta left over. I do. Because frankly, you've been in a foul mood since I sat down.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, here's my question. Why did you sit down?

speaker: Sheldon
text: To help. Look, if you fail at this relationship, and history suggests you will, then we risk losing the medical officer that our landing party has always needed.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're Kirk, I'm Spock, Worf is Scotty, Kupferpolly is the guy who always gets killed. And now we've got McCoy.

speaker: Stephanie Barnett
text: So, we're all standing around looking at the post-op X-ray and there it is, clear as day, right in the guy's chest cavity, one of my earrings. What do you think I did? I discreetly slipped off the other earring, put it in my pocket, and then got the hell out of there.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh my god! What did you do?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I have a bone to pick with you, sir.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hi Stephanie, I'm sorry I'm late, but your companion left the most indecipherable invitation.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We're going to the movies. What movie? What theater? What time? If you were trying to make it impossible to locate you, you couldn't have done a better job.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It took me nearly 20 minutes to go through the browser history on your computer to see what movie times you looked up. Wait here, I'll find us seats.
